sub: Print it, pin it on the fridge — every number from the setup guide on one page

cards.title: A Healthy Cat
list: Stable weight, waist visible from above
Clear eyes and nose, no squinting
Smooth coat, no mats or bald patches
Jumps to its usual heights without pausing
Firm, well-covered clumps in the box

cards.title: Call a Vet
list: Straining with no urine — GO TONIGHT
Any lily, antifreeze or paracetamol contact
Sudden refusal to use the back legs
New house soiling — medical until proven not

rules: One per cat plus one. It is the single highest-return decision you can make, and the one owners resist most.
Buy the box bigger than looks sensible.
A cat that cannot turn and dig will stand half out, and the floor pays for it.
Cats have a weak thirst drive. Chronic mild dehydration is what drives kidney and urinary disease later.
Give every cat a perch above four feet.
Height is where cats feel safe and how they avoid each other. A counter-surfing cat is solving a problem you gave it.
It is amputation of the last toe bone. Every scratching problem has a furniture answer instead.
